chījana.hi: छीजन, बटुक भैरव चालीसामें एक स्थान, जहाँ भैरव दौड़ गये
chījana.en: Chījana, a place in the Baṭuka Bhairava Chālīsā to which Bhairava hastened

chītaramala.en: Chītaramala, the poet of the Baṭuka Bhairava Chālīsā

daśapāṇa.en: Daśapāṇa, 'the ten-handed', a name of Bhairava

hivārā.hi: हिवारा, एक स्थान (गाँव), जहाँ ऐलादीकी कथामें भैरवजी गये
hivārā.en: Hivārā, a place (a village) Bhairava went to in this Chālīsā's story of Ailādī

kṛtyāyu.en: Kṛtyāyu, a name of Baṭuka Bhairava

saṃhāraka.en: Saṃhāraka, 'the destroyer', a name of Bhairava

trailateśa.en: Trailateśa, a name of Baṭuka Bhairava

umānanda.en: Umānanda, 'joy of Umā', a name of Bhairava
